questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

Square : Rectangle :: Rhombus : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:-

Square : Rectangle → The shape of **Square **is most similar to the **Rectangle **Shape.

 
• **Every square is a rectangle.**

Similarly,

Rhombus : Parallelogram → The shape of **Rhombus **is most similar to the **Parallelogram **shape.

 
• **Every rhombus is considered as a parallelogram** but the **converse is always not true.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question: 'Kilogram' is related to 'Vegetables' in the same way as 'Litre' is related to '________'.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:-

**"Kilogram" **is related to **"Vegetables"** → Kilogram is a method by which vegetables are weighed.

 
• *Vegetables are measured in Kilogram.*

Similarly,

**"Liter" **is related to **"Milk" **→ Liter is a method by which Milk is measured.

 
• *Milk is measured in liter.*

Hence, the correct answer is** "Milk" .**

questions.question: Six students, A, B, C, D, E and F, are standing facing north. They are not standing in alphabetical order, A is at one corner and F is beside him. B is to the immediate right of E. B is at the second place from the right end. C is not beside F. Who is standing at the right end?
questions.solution:
Given:

Six students - A, B, C, D, E, and F.

1) A is at one corner and F is beside him.

According to the above information, there are two cases:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43f67dff71d7a82004158402e5faf21bc381532c90c8ce61abcac01fcb18c8f3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80507a4cc07ff6fe38d2f6136155bf4212f7d18e8f6147dceb19adbd06267ef3.png] 

** Case (1) ** **Case (2) **

 
• As given** A **is at one corner it could be left or right. **F **is beside **A** in both cases.

2) B is at the second place from the right end.

Here case (1) gets eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ad08a98cdddcf7d4ed470a2f654fc35f549c6974e6e575123cbf89945db04eb.png] 

 
• As** B** is the second place from the right then** A **has to be in the left corner because** F** is always beside** A **and if **A** is at the right end then** F** has to be in the second place from the right end.

3) B is to the immediate right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72f564e3949b3fcd3e9b171874507a3ffedaefd69c576d2135b2a2b805ef24c3.png] 

4) C is not beside F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01256186f691b50a37f50cfc4e06dab86e1dda7e5014fd75e5198a50a0f75b91.png] 

 
• As given **C** is not beside **F** means there is the only place where **C** stands is the right end after that only place remaining for** D** is between** E** and **F**.
 
• So, according to the above diagram **"C standing at the right end"**.

Hence, the correct answer** "Option 4" ** .

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given letter series will complete the series.

C_ _U_KZU_K_UC
questions.solution:
Given: C_ _U_KZU_K_UC

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

**(1)** KZCCZ → C**KZ**U - **C**KZU - **C**K**Z**U - C

Here,** 'CKZU' **is repeated.

**(2)** ZCKZC → C**ZC**U - **K**KZU - **Z**K**C**U - C

**(3)** UKZCK → C**UK**U - **Z**KZU - **C**K**K**U - C

**(4)** CKZCZ → C**CK**U - **Z**KZU - **C**K**Z**U - C

 
• Option (1) gives a pattern of **CKZU** - CKZU - **CKZU** - C.

Hence, the correct answer is** "KZCCZ"** .

347 : 117
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

347 : 117

 
• 117 × 3 - 4 = 351 - 4 = 347

Similarly,

**242 : 82**

 
• **82 × 3 - 4 = 246 - 4 = 242**

Hence, the correct answer is **"242 : 82".**

3 ÷ 6 - 2 + 8 × 4 = 18
questions.solution:

Given equation: 3 ÷ 6 - 2 + 8 × 4 = 18

Interchanged equation is: **3 - __6 ÷ 2__** + 8 × 4 = 18

⇒ 3 - 3 + __**8 × 4**__ = 18

⇒ 3 - 3 + 32 = 18

⇒ 32 ≠ 18

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS
